summary: IN8BIO, INC. filed an ATM prospectus supplement (424B5) under its existing shelf registration to offer up to $2.8 million of common stock through JonesTrading under a Capital on Demand Sales Agreement. The at-the-market offering allows sales at prevailing market prices with a 3.0% sales agent commission. The filing is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. No deal terms such as fixed price, premium, or close date are applicable. This shelf takedown does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or any other special-situations category.
